name: steward-skills-new-repo
title: workstation-steward in Claude Code: set up a new repo
desc: An illustrative Claude Code session, looping, in two scenes. Told about a newly cloned repo, the projects skill runs steward projects scan and facets, describes the repo, and offers three choices. After the user picks onboarding with AQE and Brain, it records the decision, shows the onboard plan (nine files, kept out of git status), asks, applies it with a receipt, and names the one step left to the user.

scenes.cmd: I just cloned acme/web into ~/Development/web. Set it up.

scenes.out: ⎿  stack node/ts · node 26.12.1 · no AI tool files yet

segs: ~/Development/web is new: a Node and TypeScript repo with no AI tool files. Your other node/ts repos

scenes.out: use AQE and Brain. How should the steward treat it?
⎿  0 edit, 9 create, 0 PR (not applied: rollout), 0 manual

segs: The plan creates 9 files (Claude and Codex settings, the AQE hook, its skills, commands and agents),

scenes.out: and lists them in .git/info/exclude so git status stays clean. Nothing tracked changes. Apply it?

segs: Done. One step is yours: open Claude Code in ~/Development/web and approve the agentic-qe server

scenes.out: and the AQE hooks when asked. To undo: steward projects onboard --rollback <that receipt>.
